name: Nomad
description:
You've spent your life moving from place to place, carrying your culture with you.

You can always find other members of your Culture in any town or city.

Whenever you spend more than 1 week in a single location, check a Condition. You cannot uncheck this Condition until you spend at least 1 day away from the location.

Once per Quest: When you arrive in a Culture you've never visited before, double your current Hope.

Describe how you stay on the move.
